clue.text: More ready to assist the players?

definitions.meaning: comparative of prompt, meaning quick or ready
the theatre person who feeds forgotten lines to actors

explanation.definitionFit: Prompt means quick, so its comparative fits 'more ready'; a theatre prompter whispers forgotten lines to actors on stage.

clue.text: Downtrodden, may in: strigate revolution

parts.note: bicycle parts are literally trodden down by the feet, and that pushing sets the wheels turning round, a revolution in the mechanical sense

explanation.surface: An oppressed people might rise up and start a revolution.
explanation.definitionFit: Cycle pedals are pushed down by foot and their motion turns the crank and wheels in revolutions.

clue.text: Figure. Is ex-pupil-of rangy build

parts.note: OB stands for old boy, a former pupil of a school
rangy means tall and lanky, so long

explanation.surface: A former schoolboy is described as tall and lanky in physique.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Figure' here is a geometric shape, not a person's body, though the surface about build pushes that way.
explanation.definitionFit: A rectangle longer than it is wide is a plane shape, a geometric figure.

clue.text: Speaking of fa standard weapon

parts.note: par is the standard or normal level
a lance is a long spear carried by a knight

explanation.surface: A discussion about a regulation-issue weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: Parlance is a manner of speech or idiom, as in 'in common parlance'.

clue.text: Cleft sticks to hold them?

indicators.note: the two words hold the answer within them, running across the gap between them

explanation.surface: Forked sticks might be used to pin down small amphibians.
explanation.definitionFit: Young newts, small amphibians, might be pinned in a forked stick by a collector.

clue.text: Pain caused by the needle?

definitions.meaning: a sharp pain in the side, as when running
a single loop of thread made by a sewing needle

explanation.definitionFit: A sudden side pain from running shares its name with a single pass of thread in sewing.

clue.text: Flow of invective when one gets stuck in traffic

indicators.note: the word for one is lodged inside the word for traffic

parts.note: traffic in the sense of commerce, trade
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Road rage: someone stuck in a jam lets rip with abuse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'traffic' suggests cars, but here it is the verb-noun for dealing, trade.
explanation.definitionFit: A tirade is a long angry speech, a torrent of abuse.

clue.text: Bear grabs a piece of cake then leaves container

annotationWithheld.why: Bear grabs a piece of cake then leaves container: TEDDY around ACA gives the answer, but 'a piece of cake then leaves' yields A + C only; no word supplies the second A
annotationWithheld.clue: Bear grabs a piece of cake then leaves container

clue.text: Making an accumulation — of bills?

definitions.meaning: stockpiling or amassing a store
a large board on which posters or bills are pasted

explanation.definitionFit: Stockpiling goods is hoarding; a hoarding is also a billboard where posters are stuck up.

clue.text: The same religious ceremony the French held by the rock

parts.note: DO is short for ditto, meaning the same
le is French for the
a rite is a religious ritual

explanation.surface: A repeated church service and a French group gather by a crag.
explanation.walkthrough: 'held by the' is linking only; the pieces simply run in answer order.
explanation.definitionFit: Dolerite is a dark igneous stone, a kind of basalt.

clue.text: Girl with leading member of the naval force

indicators.note: the limb word goes in front of the girl's name

parts.note: an arm is a limb, a member of the body
Ada is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A woman joins a senior officer of the navy.
explanation.definitionFit: An armada is a fleet of warships, as in the Spanish Armada of 1588.

clue.text: Bloomer-could be a big one

indicators.note: the letters of the phrase could be rearranged into something else

explanation.surface: A blunder might turn out to be a serious one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bloomer' reads as a mistake, but it means something that blooms, a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: A begonia is a flowering garden plant, something that blooms.

clue.text: Acceleration in vessel of one dimension

indicators.note: the letter for acceleration is placed inside the ship

parts.note: a liner is an ocean-going passenger ship
a is the symbol for acceleration in physics

explanation.surface: A ship picks up speed, measured along a single axis.
explanation.definitionFit: Linear means arranged along a line, having length only.

clue.text: Chief to settle the point

parts.note: head means chief or principal
to land is to come down and settle

explanation.surface: A leader comes to resolve the matter at issue.
explanation.definitionFit: A headland is a promontory, a coastal point jutting into the sea.

clue.text: Chemical making vehicle stop moving

parts.note: a car is a motor vehicle
to bide is to stay or remain where one is

explanation.surface: A substance that brings a car to a halt.
explanation.definitionFit: Carbide is a compound of carbon with a metal, a chemical substance.

clue.text: Company returns got an improvised figure

indicators.note: the abbreviation for company is turned back to front
the letters of these two words are thrown together freshly

explanation.surface: A firm's annual returns produced a makeshift number.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' reverses CO to give OC; 'improvised' turns GOT AN into TAGON.
explanation.definitionFit: An eight-sided polygon is a plane geometric shape.

clue.text: A hide-out by the Red Sea

parts.note: a den is a hiding place or lair

explanation.surface: A secret refuge on the shore of the Red Sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Aden is a Yemeni port city near the southern mouth of the Red Sea.

clue.text: I disparage an insular person

parts.note: to slander is to speak ill of, disparage

explanation.surface: Someone admits to belittling a narrow-minded person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'insular' suggests narrow-minded, but it literally means of an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Insular literally means of an island, so an islander is an island dweller.

clue.text: Devotee of the sport chases pigeons

parts.note: a fan is an enthusiast, especially of a sport
to tail is to follow closely

explanation.surface: A sports enthusiast runs after birds.
explanation.definitionFit: Fantails are a breed of domestic pigeon with spread fan-shaped tails.

clue.text: He doesn't believe in acting so wickedly

indicators.note: the letters of the fodder behave badly and are jumbled

explanation.surface: A sceptic refuses to accept that someone could behave so badly.
explanation.definitionFit: An agnostic holds that God's existence cannot be known, so does not affirm belief.

clue.text: Close the envelope and put a stamp on it

definitions.meaning: to fasten shut, as by licking the flap
to press an official mark or emblem into wax

explanation.definitionFit: To seal is both to fasten a letter shut and to mark it with an impressed stamp of authority.

clue.text: Cut over the nose?

definitions.meaning: to shorten a text
the bony ridge at the top of the nose, read as two words, a bridge

explanation.definitionFit: To shorten a book is to cut it; split as A BRIDGE, it is the ridge across the nose.

clue.text: Mast badly rigged again going into the water

indicators.note: the word for again goes inside the jumbled letters
a mast badly rigged is set up wrongly, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: re- is a prefix meaning again

explanation.surface: A badly rigged mast is refitted before going overboard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly rigged' is the anagram signal on the sailing word, and 'going into' puts the prefix inside it; 'the water' points to a flowing body of water, not the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A stream is a small river, a body of flowing water.

clue.text: Student also gets on to. French vehicle

parts.note: L is a learner, as on British learner-driver plates
and means also, in addition
au is French for to the

explanation.surface: A pupil also climbs aboard a carriage bound for France.
explanation.definitionFit: A landau is a four-wheeled horse-drawn carriage with a folding top.

clue.text: Risk the unexpected

definitions.meaning: to venture or gamble
fortune or accident, what happens unforeseen

explanation.definitionFit: To venture is to take a gamble, and luck or accident is what happens by fortune.

clue.text: Elevation follows latitude in reorganisation

indicators.note: the letters of the geography word are reorganised into a new order

explanation.surface: Height on a map comes after the reading of position north or south.
explanation.walkthrough: 'follows' is a link here; the anagram uses only LATITUDE.
explanation.definitionFit: Altitude is height above sea level, elevation.

clue.text: Chemical deposit — from a reefer?

parts.note: a reefer is a cannabis cigarette, slang pot
ash is the residue deposited after burning

explanation.surface: A powdery residue left after smoking a joint.
explanation.definitionFit: Potash is potassium carbonate, an alkaline compound used in fertilisers.

clue.text: Overhead light a good thing to have

definitions.meaning: a ring of light around the sun, moon or a saint's head
a sign of saintly virtue, worn by the good

explanation.definitionFit: A halo is a circle of light above a saint's head, the mark of holiness.

clue.text: Motorist's club

definitions.meaning: one who drives a car; the 's reads as is
a golf club with a large head for long shots

explanation.definitionFit: A motorist is someone at the wheel, and in golf the longest-hitting wooden club bears the same name.

clue.text: Mother spots retreating game — this type won't be seen again

definitions.text: this type won't be seen again

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother

indicators.note: the word for spots goes backwards

parts.note: dots are small spots
game means willing, as is on, in 'I'm on'

explanation.surface: Mum sees game animals running away, a species never to return.
explanation.definitionFit: The mastodon is an extinct elephant-like mammal, gone forever.

clue.text: Carry on with the account, in short

definitions.meaning: to start again after a pause
a summary, or a brief career outline

explanation.definitionFit: To continue after a break is to resume; a résumé is a summary or CV.

clue.text: Decide to put an end to things

definitions.meaning: to reach a judgement or settle
to bring to a close, finish

explanation.definitionFit: To conclude is both to reach a judgement and to finish something.
